name: claude2feishu
description: Claude Code ↔ 飞书双向通信

scripts.start: nohup npx tsx src/index.ts > ~/.claude/feishu/service.log 2>&1 & sleep 1 && curl -s http://127.0.0.1:${FEISHU_NOTIFYD_PORT:-9876}/health | python3 -m json.tool 2>/dev/null || echo '(check status)'
scripts.stop: kill $(cat ~/.claude/feishu/service.pid 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null && echo '✅ stopped' || echo '⚠️  not running'
scripts.status: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:${FEISHU_NOTIFYD_PORT:-9876}/health 2>/dev/null | python3 -m json.tool || echo '❌ not running'
